 F.R.I.D.A.Y's heartbreaking 'VisionQuest' monologue on Tony Stark's death in 'Avengers: Endgame' has fans in tears: 'Half the world came back that day and I lost half of mine'- WATCH

 TOI Entertainment Desk / etimes.in / Oct 21, 2026, 10:46 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Marvel fans are revisiting one of the MCU's most emotional moments through an unexpected perspective, and it has left many viewers heartbroken. In the all-new episode of ‘VisionQuest’, Orla Brady’s F.R.I.D.A.Y. delivers a heartbreaking monologue about Tony Stark’s death in ‘Avengers: Endgame’, revealing the guilt she carries over being unable to save the man she was programmed to protect. F.R.I.D.A.Y's emotional monologue goes viral
 The emotional scene features in Episode 3 which brings together several artificial intelligence programmes associated with Stark, played by Robert Downey Jr and Vision played by Paul Bettany. While Tony’s sacrifice in ‘Avengers: Endgame’ was witnessed by characters including Pepper Potts, Rhodey and Peter Parker, the series explores the tragedy from the perspective of F.R.I.D.A.Y., the AI who assisted Tony in his Iron Man suit. Recalling her time working for Stark and the events of the battle against Thanos, F.R.I.D.A.Y. speaks about her purpose, the lives she helped save and the moment she failed to protect her creator. “I was there when Tony died. I ran over a quintillion strategic calculations that day, and I still couldn't save him. Half the world came back that day, and I lost half of mine.” Fans react to F.R.I.D.A.Y.’s emotional monologue
 The monologue has seemed to have particularly struck a chord with viewers. Following the episode, fans took to social media to share their reactions, with many praising the emotional depth of the scene and Orla Brady’s performance. “The way Friday talks about Tony and her grief absolutely breaks my heart,” one viewer wrote. Another fan highlighted F.R.I.D.A.Y.’s sense of helplessness, writing, “Hearing FRIDAY's perspective helplessly watching Tony die and the survivor's guilt she feels not being able to do her one job of protecting him cuts so deep, what a monologue from Orla Brady.” “OH MY GOD FRIDAY BLAMES HERSELF FOR TONY DYING,” another fan reacted. One viewer called it the most heartbreaking scene in ‘VisionQuest’, recalling the silence that followed Tony’s death in theatres when ‘Avengers: Endgame’ was originally released. “The most heart wrenching scene of VisionQuest. They took us right back to the biggest moment of the MCU. That time the theater went silent….. We get a perspective we never thought about….. F.R.I.D.A.Y.’s. She did everything she could and had to tell Pepper vitals were dying. This show is about AI and still has soul…. Impressive!” ‘VisionQuest’ revisits Tony Stark’s legacy
 Starring Paul Bettany as Vision, ‘VisionQuest’ continues the story of the character following the events of ‘WandaVision’ and ‘Agatha All Along’. As Vision attempts to understand his identity and purpose, the series explores the artificial intelligence programmes embedded in his system, including F.R.I.D.A.Y., E.D.I.T.H., J.A.R.V.I.S. and Ultron. It is still unclear if the series will play a role in the upcoming 'Avengers: Doomsday'.
